canonical_project: Le Vasa cable landing station (Tafuna CLS)
owner: ASTCA (American Samoa Telecommunications Authority); modular CLS by DXN
notes: FCC public notices (DA-26-578A1, DA-26-296A1) state ASTCA will construct a cable landing station and beach joint in Tafuna, Tutuila and own/operate the Le Vasa system connecting to Google/Starfish Bulikula (BU 1A); FCC OIA approved the application June 2026. Samoa News (2026-07-07) reports DXN won an AU$1m (~US$690k) contract to design/manufacture/deliver/commission the modular CLS hosting Le Vasa, delivery due March 2027; system expected operational Q3 2026. Per methodology this is telecom_cable_station/connectivity infrastructure, NOT a commercial datacenter (no colo/rack hosting service confirmed).
